records.text: A Stormwind city guard who helps visitors find city services, the harbor, and the Deeprun Tram. When trouble escalates, he warns that he may use force.
Roberto Pupellyverbos is a Stormwind merchant who sells goods and welcomes customers to browse his wares.

Morgan Pestle shares Pestle’s Apothecary in Stormwind’s Trade District with his brother William. He awaits William’s candle shipment, and William tells a courier that Morgan will pay well for delivering it.

Caretaker Folsom succeeded his father in looking after the Flintridge estate. His father had to clean up after a massacre there. Folsom remembers a storm-night visitor named Stalvan who fled in fear, leaving letters behind.
Maginor Dumas is a Master Mage who offers mage training and guidance to those learning magic. He warns that magic can burn the untrained and advises travelers to be wary of it.

Master Mathias Shaw leads SI:7 in Stormwind. Asked about the Defias and Stonemasons, Shaw identifies Edwin VanCleef as the guild’s leader and the man responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the First War. Shaw reports that VanCleef’s men were apparently unhappy with the King’s treatment after reconstruction and sends Gryan Stoutmantle a fuller account in Westfall.

npcs.name: Mazen Mac'Nadir

records.text: Mazen Mac’Nadir cares for the Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences’ library, with responsibility for accounting for its magical tomes and scrolls. Mazen fears the harm these enchanted works could cause in the wrong hands. Calling the assistant Dellis capable in the library but incompetent outside Stormwind, Mazen seeks help correcting a recent mistake.

npcs.title: Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences

records.text: Kendor Kabonka sells cooking recipes in Stormwind.

Dungar Longdrink is Stormwind’s gryphon master, offering paid flights and praising routes that cannot be reached on foot. Dungar helps arrange Osric’s crate delivery to Quartermaster Lewis at Sentinel Hill via Thor, the Westfall gryphon master. Dungar explains that riders must previously have visited a remote gryphon master before taking a flight there.
High Priestess Laurena trains priests and offers guidance in the priestly ways. She urges visitors to remain faithful to the Light.

Demisette Cloyce trains warlocks in Stormwind and doubts that untested novices should help create items of power, while acknowledging that the choice is not hers. She is surprised when students endure arcane corruption without going mad and urges them to test their skill further. She directs them to Menara Voidrender above Ratchet for guidance.

General Marcus Jonathan is High Commander of Stormwind Defense. He receives Magistrate Solomon’s urgent report seeking reinforcements for besieged Lakeshire and sends a letter back while awaiting the King’s response.

Elling Trias, Stormwind’s Master of Cheese, is a contact in the investigation linking Marzon, the Defias and Lord Lescovar. After Lescovar’s threat is dealt with, he directs a report to Mathias Shaw and warns the investigator not to let noble attention go to their head. He insists that the nobles’ belief that they rule the city does not put everything in their hands.

Elaine Trias is Stormwind’s Mistress of Cheese, promoting her wares as the city’s best deals. She greets Corbett by name, brings him freshly made cheese and asks how business is going at his clothier shop.

Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind survived the collapse of a mine beneath a Moonbrook barn. He seeks news of his brother, Foreman Thistlenettle, and hopes the foreman’s Explorers’ League badge might give him peace of mind. Having lost many friends in the collapse, Wilder asks for their Miners’ Union cards so he can bring their families some resolution.

Ander Germaine trains warriors in Stormwind and regards the city as sustained by strength of will and a sturdy blade. He judges a nonwarrior by their stance and dismissively suggests doing something safe, such as reading a book. He offers warrior training, talent retraining and information about dual specialization.
Osborne is a rogue trainer. His greeting is wary and wry: he jokes that a visitor looks like someone he should watch around his coin purse, then asks how he can help.

Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker trains paladins in Stormwind. He emphasizes sacrifice and judgment, insisting that High Priest Rohan receive fair compensation for his exorcism censer even when it will serve a just cause. Grayson recommends respected paladin Tiza Battleforge to younger dwarven paladins learning more about the Light and their responsibilities.
Dane Lindgren is an apprentice blacksmith in Stormwind. In one greeting, Dane brusquely asks whether there is time to stand around talking.

Angus Stern is the Blue Recluse's head chef, developing a rural, bayou-themed menu for its clientele. He sent his nephew Morgan to Theramore to gather local recipes, since the trip is too long for Angus himself.
Bishop Farthing advises those preparing to face Morbent Fel to seek Lightforge Iron, directing them to his colleague Glorin Steelbrow in Menethil Harbor.
Keldric Boucher sells alchemy supplies and reagents and welcomes customers who want to browse or ask for help finding goods.
Kyra Boucher sells reagents and welcomes customers to browse, offering help finding goods.

Archbishop Benedictus leads Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He calls on the Light to oppose the Scourge, including Amnennar at Razorfen Downs, and is asked to help with the curse on the Eye of Paleth.
Thurman Mullby sells general goods and greets customers with a friendly claim to offer Stormwind's best deals, then asks what he can help them find.
Edna Mullby sells trade supplies and offers to help customers find what they need.
Marda Weller is a weapons merchant who offers goods for browsing and repairs.
Gunther Weller is a weapons merchant who offers goods for browsing and repairs.
Carla Granger is a cloth armor merchant who offers goods for browsing and repairs.
Maris Granger is a skinning trainer with little patience for idle chatter. She asks visitors to say what they need and get to the point.
Aldric Moore sells mail armor, invites customers to browse and offers help finding particular goods. Aldric boasts of the best deals in Stormwind.
Lara Moore is a leather armor merchant who offers customers a chance to browse her goods.
Lina Stover is a bow and gun merchant who offers customers a chance to browse her goods.
Frederick Stover is a bow and arrow merchant who invites visitors to browse his goods.
Lisbeth Schneider is a clothier who invites visitors to browse her goods.
Lawrence Schneider is presented as an apprentice tailor. One greeting uses weaving as a metaphor for life.
Julia Gallina sells wine, invites customers to browse and offers help finding particular goods. Julia boasts of the best deals in Stormwind.
Bernard Gump is a florist who offers flowers for occasions. His greeting presents his business as Stormwind's sole supplier of healthy flowers.
Felicia Gump sells herbalism supplies and invites customers to browse her goods.
Darian Singh is a fireworks vendor in Stormwind. He says he sells only the finest arcane gear, made by the city's crafters and mages.
Jarel Moor tends bar and cautions patrons against sitting near the shadows.

Charys Yserian sells arcane trinkets in Stormwind and praises the city’s crafters and mages. Recalling the fall of Dalaran and destruction of Quel’Thalas, Charys describes such wares as difficult to obtain and credits Lucan Cordell and other tradesmen with filling orders with quality merchandise.

Owen Vaughn sells reagents in Stormwind. Recalling the fall of Dalaran and destruction of Quel’Thalas, Owen describes arcane wares as difficult to obtain and credits Lucan Cordell and other tradesmen with supplying quality merchandise.

Wynne Larson sells robes at Larson Clothiers in Stormwind’s Mage District and crafts garments for mages. The first commission uses linen and charged rift gems; a finer robe calls for pristine spider silk. Wynne praises the supplied pieces before getting to work, searches for a misplaced silver spool and announces when a robe is finished.
Evan Larson is a Stormwind hatter who sells arcane gear made by the city's crafters and mages.
Joachim Brenlow tends the Blue Recluse, welcoming magically inclined patrons and offering service at the bar.
Ardwyn Cailen is a wand merchant who offers goods for sale.
Maria Lumere supplies alchemy goods for sale.
Duncan Cullen is a light armor merchant who sells his wares and repairs gear.
Allan Hafgan is a staves merchant who sells his wares and repairs gear.
Adair Gilroy is a librarian who offers goods for sale.
Lucan Cordell is an enchanting trainer who offers to guide those with what it takes.
Jessara Cordell sells enchanting supplies, including arcane gear made by Stormwind's crafters and mages.
Bryan Cross is a shield merchant and repairer. He keeps prices firm and sends customers who want to haggle to a Goblin.
Seoman Griffith sells leather armor. His prices are set, and he tells customers who want to haggle to find a Goblin.
Alyssa Griffith sells bags. Her prices are set, and she tells customers who want to haggle to find a Goblin.

Osric Strang is a heavy armor merchant whose work connects Stormwind with Westfall: he sends equipment west and receives a note from Lewis. He keeps prices fixed and advises customers seeking a bargain to find a Goblin.
Heinrich Stone is a blade merchant. His sales greeting says prices are fixed and directs customers who want to haggle to a Goblin.
Jasper Fel is a shady dealer who offers goods for sale. He urges visitors to speak quietly and carefully, warning that a wrong word in these parts could bring danger.
Sloan McCoy is a poison-supplies dealer. He urges discretion, warning that careless words can be dangerous.
Reese Langston is a tavernkeeper who welcomes visitors to the Pig and Whistle and invites them to share a drink and a seat.
Elly Langston is a barmaid who greets customers warmly and asks what they fancy. She recommends ale for a tough day and returns rude gestures in kind.
Gerik Koen is a two-handed weapon merchant who invites customers to browse his goods. He says his gear is tested and true, his prices are fixed, and haggling belongs with a Goblin.
Mayda Thane is a cobbler who sells goods and repairs equipment.
Wilhelm Strang is a mail armor merchant who sells goods and repairs equipment.
Georgio Bolero is a tailoring trainer who offers tailoring training.

Alexandra Bolero sells tailoring supplies in Stormwind and invites visitors to browse. Alexandra recalls shortages following the fall of Dalaran and destruction of Quel’Thalas, and praises Lucan Cordell and other local tradesmen for filling orders with quality merchandise.
Gregory Ardus sells staffs and maces and offers help to customers browsing his goods.
Agustus Moulaine is a mail armor merchant who offers visitors help browsing his goods.
Theresa Moulaine is a robe vendor who wishes visitors well and offers help if they need it while browsing her goods.
Brother Cassius is a reagent merchant who offers visitors help browsing his goods.
Adam urges quiet while fishing, suggests the bridge as another place to fish, and reacts skeptically to fish stories.
Billy tells stories about extraordinary fish, recounts an enormous catch, and boasts that his father can catch more than the listener's father.

Justin tells dramatic tales of battles and strange creatures, alongside rumors about Stormwind's canals and distant peoples. His speech ranges from local curiosities to extravagant claims, making him a lively storyteller whose tales are not dependable history.
Brandon responds to stories with lively doubt, citing his father's view and comparing Billy's fish stories with exaggeration. His remarks show conversational hearsay.
Roman talks about fishing in the canals, reacting to possible bites, odd smells and worm-covered shoes. His remarks stay close to what he sees and catches.
Complains that Alliance towers were built behind his farm; asks for alms, jokes about being blind, and offers to polish armor.
A panhandler who says orcs burned his farm. He asks for alms, jokes about blindness, and offers to polish armor.
Morris Lawry begs for coins, offers to shine armor for a copper, blames the Alliance army for building towers behind his farm, and jokes about pretending to be blind.
Analyzes how Essence flows and opposing energies affect a portal, including how a binding cantrip could stabilize it and magical wards might contain an entity.

Lisan Pierce is a cautious participant in magical experimentation, probing the risks of unstable energies and faulty casting. She recalls a prior mishap and questions a formula associated with Adept Syleria.

Suzanne is working through competing magical theories and precise ways to stabilize a spell. Her proposals draw a skeptical response, but she stays upbeat; the elaborate experiment is for a love potion, and she hopes its intended recipient is worth the effort.
Grimand Elmore is a weaponsmith. He works with armor and weapons, including lightforge iron, and speaks with easy confidence about his craftsmanship, joking about stout.
Fizzles is a beast in Stormwind City.
Harlan Bagley sells knitted clothing and manages his stock. He appreciates prompt deliveries and values regular business relationships.
Rema Schneider handles knitted-goods resupplies for Harlan Bagley. She is Thurman Schneider's mother and sends him a sewing kit for his tailoring apprenticeship.
Thurman Schneider is Rema Schneider's son and an apprentice at Larson Clothiers; Rema says he forgot his shears and needles and sends his sewing kit.
Suzetta is Renato Gallina's sister and helps sell the family's wine. Renato directs customers to her for a complimentary bottle of their pinot noir.
Renato promotes the Gallina family's wine in Stormwind and directs customers to his sister Suzetta for a complimentary bottle. His pitch has a playful, melodramatic flourish.

Zardeth of the Black Claw is involved in a Stormwind warlock establishment that Lord Wishock is pressing to investigate. He devises a special stout to keep Wishock occupied and seeks help gathering its ingredients and delivering it.
Lord Baurles K. Wishock is a noble associated with the House of Nobles.
Milton Sheaf is Stormwind's head librarian. He knows the Royal Library's shelves and can retrieve books such as The Stresses of Iron.
Brother Kristoff invokes the Light in his blessing to visitors, asking it to guide their path.
Morgg Stormshot is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Christoph Faral is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Aedis Brom is a humanoid in Stormwind City.

Baros Alexston is Stormwind's city architect and a former Stonemason who worked with Edwin VanCleef rebuilding the city. He says the guild was cheated of its pay after the work, and directs those seeking VanCleef's plans to Bazil Thredd.
Warden Thelwater is unsettled by the sudden uprising and suspects someone helped the prisoners. He fears the captain will blame him and is anxious about what to do.
Nikova Raskol grieves her murdered grandson Mac, who was killed by Defias prisoners, and seeks revenge against them.
Zggi serves Zardeth the Blackclaw as his minion.
Anduin Wrynn is the Prince of Stormwind. He welcomes people to Stormwind.

Highlord Bolvar Fordragon directs visitors to Mathias Shaw’s Stormwind barracks to investigate Nathanos Marris’s disappearance. He describes Nathanos as a human ranger lord and Sylvanas Windrunner’s disciple, presumed lost in the defense of Lordaeron without a recovered body. He also sends visitors to Field Marshal Afrasiabi in the Valley of Heroes.
Lady Katrana Prestor is a noblewoman.
Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth, a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Mithras Ironhill is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Caledra Dawnbreeze is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Lord Gregor Lescovar is a secretive lord who seeks news from Westfall and suspects that Shaw is interfering. He plans to investigate before sending his visitor away.
A Stormwind Royal Guard responds formally and courteously to visitors, including directing one to Lord Lescovar in the library.

A Stormwind City patroller offers directions to the auction house, bank, Stormwind Harbor, and Deeprun Tram. They warn or threaten people who cause trouble, including those who spill blood on neutral ground.
Crier Goodman greets visitors and offers news from both continents and beyond.
Count Remington Ridgewell of the House of Nobles is involved in recovering the Perenolde Tiara and receives Ridgewell's Crate.
Shaina Fuller is a First Aid trainer whose greeting addresses fellow physicians and offers instruction useful on their journeys.
Karlee Chaddis speaks affectionately to Paige and familiarly with Charys, reflecting personal relationships with both.
Paige Chaddis asks her mother for permission to pet Fizzles.
Major Samuelson is a Stormwind City Guard officer and Farren's former mentor. Farren hopes Samuelson can help him return to Stormwind.
Olivia Burnside is a banker at the Bank of Stormwind, which offers financial accounts and safety deposit boxes.
Newton Burnside is a banker at the Bank of Stormwind, which offers financial accounts and safety deposit boxes.
John Burnside is a Stormwind banker who offers financial accounts and safety deposit boxes.
Larimaine Purdue is a portal trainer who teaches mages about portal magic.
Donyal Tovald is a librarian in Stormwind City.
Donna is distressed over Betsy, her doll, and pleads for whoever has her to stop hurting her. She says she will tell her mother.
William boasts that he has Betsy, calls her the listener's dolly, and threatens to make her swim. He demands that the listener beg for her return, then mocks them as a crybaby.
Archmage Malin describes Archmage Trelane as his original master and asks an adventurer to help recover items Trelane left behind after Stromgarde fell under siege.
Lenny "Fingers" McCoy is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Karrina Mekenda is a pet trainer who says she only helps hunters and their pets.
Gil asks about canal crocolisks and wants to see the Mage Tower; he also complains that his feet hurt and asks where they are going.
Pat is a humanoid found in Stormwind.
Andi is a humanoid found in Stormwind.
Mikey is a humanoid found in Stormwind.
Geoff is a humanoid found in Stormwind.
Twain is a humanoid found in Stormwind.
Steven asks his teacher about Stormwind sights, complains about studying, and says another student keeps poking him.
Jimmy asks whether paladins train here.

Miss Danna is a Stormwind school mistress who guides children on a city tour. She explains the Cathedral's religious role, Stormwind Keep's rebuilding after the First War, and the Valley of Heroes' memorial to the two Great Wars.
Thomas Miller is a baker who offers freshly baked bread, rolls, and buns.
Ol' Emma is an elderly woman who talks to herself. She grumbles about hauling water and doing work for others, and her remarks can be ornery.
The Sewer Beast is a beast of Stormwind City.
Jenn Langston warmly greets patrons and offers ale, inviting casual conversation. She answers a rude gesture in kind.
Erich Lohan promotes the Blue Recluse with calls for drinks, atmosphere, and relaxation after magical study.
Steven Lohan welcomes weary travelers to his inn and asks how he can help.
David Langston is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Collin Mauren is a human mage working with Gaxim on a remote detonation device. He is preparing a messaging spell on a scroll and needs dust devil debris among its components.

Jorgen is a guarded intermediary in the missing diplomat investigation. He passes a sealed note to Elling Trias and insists that it be delivered without discussion, reflecting his discreet, serious approach.
Bishop DeLavey is a bishop in Stormwind City.
Dashel Stonefist is a brawler involved in the kidnapping plot. When pressed, he ends the fight and tells his associates to back off.
Aldwin Laughlin is the Guild Master at Stormwind's Guild Registry, where he welcomes visitors seeking help.
Ben Trias, an Apprentice of Cheese, boasts of the best deals in Stormwind and invites customers to browse his goods.
Thomas is an altar boy acting at Bishop DeLavey's request. He quietly directs adventurers to the bishop in Stormwind Keep to discuss a delicate matter.
Argos is a traveler seeking a seasoned adventurer’s help for his brother, Gershala, who needs assistance in Darkshore.
A guard in the Stockade.
An injured guard in the Stockade.
Nurse Lillian offers patients simple care and reassurance, including drinks, ointment, and help as they recover.

Apprentice chef Connor Rivers credits James Hyal, one of the best chefs and innkeepers he knew, with his training and success. He wonders how James is doing and hopes a traveler can pass along a greeting through James's brother Vincent.
Rebecca Laughlin designs tabards and welcomes visitors to the Stormwind Guild Registry.
Brohann Caskbelly is an elderly member of the Explorers' League. His final expedition searched from the air for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, but he never found it.

Acolyte Dellis is Master Mazen's library assistant, entrusted with carrying Khadgar's Essays on Dimensional Convergence to Watcher Mahar Ba. He says he took a wrong turn in the Swamp of Sorrows and dropped the essay while fleeing plant-like creatures. He recalls the journey as frightening and asks for help recovering the essay.
Furen Longbeard makes armor and records techniques learned through the work. He sends copies of his notes to Grimand Elmore and other associates.
Wu Shen trains warriors and regards Stormwind as the pillar of the human race, sustained by strength of will and a sturdy blade.
Ilsa Corbin is a warrior trainer who offers warrior training and talent-related services. Her greeting praises Stormwind's strength and its people.
Stephen Ryback is a cooking trainer. He says he rarely gets cooks seeking instruction, but is willing to teach those who are ready.
Erika Tate sells cooking supplies. She calls her goods tested and true and her prices fixed; anyone who wants to haggle can go find a Goblin.
Brother Benjamin is a priest trainer. He invokes the Light in his greeting and urges priests not to turn away from it.
Brother Joshua offers priest training and information about dual talent specialization.
Arthur the Faithful offers paladin instruction in the ways of the Light and guidance about dual talent specialization.
Katherine the Pure offers paladin instruction in the ways of the Light and guidance about dual talent specialization.
Arnold Leland is a fishing trainer who offers instruction to visitors.
Catherine Leland sells fishing supplies to customers browsing her wares.
Ursula Deline is a warlock trainer.
Sandahl is a warlock trainer. His counsel is severe: he warns that arcane power corrupts the weak.
Jennea Cannon is a mage trainer who advises mages to treat magic carefully, warning that it can burn the untrained.
Elsharin trains mages, offers talent unlearning and dual talent specialization, and warns that untrained magic can burn.
Lilyssia Nightbreeze teaches alchemy and longs to join the battles outside the city walls; for now, she shares her knowledge with others who fight in her stead.
Tel'Athir is an apprentice alchemist who longs for news from Teldrassil and asks visitors for tidings from abroad.
Shylamiir is an herbalism trainer.
Eldraeith sells herbalism supplies and presents them as crafts from Teldrassil, carried from Kalimdor to symbolize growing ties between the Great Tree's people and humans.
Sheldras Moontree is a druid trainer.
Theridran is a druid trainer who offers instruction to visitors.
Maldryn is a druid trainer who welcomes prospective trainees warmly and teaches that tranquility and balance can be found by looking within, even amid a sheltered town.

Kathrum Axehand is an axe merchant who pitches his goods by arguing that the gnomish subway makes transport from Ironforge easy and that visitors need not accept import fees from human traders in the Bazaar.
Thulman Flintcrag sells guns and warns buyers against import fees. He says the gnomes’ subway makes transporting goods from Ironforge easier than buyers may think.
Therum Deepforge trains blacksmiths, urging aspiring smiths to take up an apron and hammer.
Kaita Deepforge sells blacksmithing supplies and warns buyers against import fees. Kaita says the gnomes’ subway makes transporting goods from Ironforge easier than buyers may think.
Gelman Stonehand trains mining and answers interruptions with blunt impatience.
Brooke Stonebraid sells mining supplies and promotes the gnome-built subway as a way to bring goods from Ironforge. She resents import fees and urges customers to buy from her.
Einris Brightspear trains hunters and urges them to learn from beasts: observe like an owl, learn a sabercat’s cleverness and embody a wolf’s mighty spirit.
Ulfir Ironbeard is a hunter trainer who offers instruction in the hunter's ways. His counsel points hunters toward learning from the wisdom and qualities of beasts.
Thorfin Stoneshield trains hunters. The teaching outlook is to learn from beasts, observing the owl's wisdom, the sabercat's cleverness, and the wolf's spirit.

Lilliam Sparkspindle trains engineers and introduces aspiring experts to the gnome and goblin disciplines. The supplied descriptions favor gnome engineering and joke that goblin work centers on explosives.
Billibub Cogspinner sells engineering supplies. In one exchange, he jokes about an assembly mistake going boom and points the customer to Lilliam for assembly advice.
Spackle Thornberry is a contact in a dreadsteed ritual involving Mor’zul Bloodbringer.
Simon Tanner trains leatherworkers. He calls Randal a dandy but dependable and says some students seek adventure.
Jillian Tanner supplies leatherworking goods and presents herself as selling tested gear at fixed prices; would-be hagglers are directed elsewhere.
Tannysa trains herbalists and speaks confidently about her expertise. In one exchange, she says she was interrupted during important work and expects a good reason for it.
Sellandus is an apprentice tailor who greets visitors courteously.
High Sorcerer Andromath serves the mages of Stormwind. He seeks the return of Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic and directs aid for Nethergarde's research into the Dark Portals.

Harry Burlguard is a veteran warrior and teacher usually found at the Pig and Whistle tavern in Stormwind’s Old Town. Before teaching a young warrior, Harry tests the moves the student already knows by asking them to get Bartleby’s mug, amused that the drunk will not simply hand it over.
Bartleby is a drunk who refuses to give up his mug, insisting that someone will have to take it from him by force.
Gakin the Darkbinder is a warlock mentor who remembers Surena Caledon as a talented former student; he accuses her of betrayal and seeks the bloodstone choker he gave her.

Duthorian Rall teaches that a paladin should reflect the Light through good actions, compassion, patience, and bravery, and that helping others matters as much as strength in battle. He urges those he guides to remain virtuous and prepare for trials.

Gazin Tenorm and Henze Faulk went to Heroes' Vigil to investigate the Defias presence and gather proof for the king's advisors. After spotting Defias reviewing documents, they were overwhelmed; Henze held them off so Gazin could escape.
Stephanie Turner cares for the orphanage children, struggling to provide food, shelter, and clothing. Her husband John gathers materials so she can sew clothes for them.
A Stockade Archer is a humanoid archer found in Stormwind.
Acolyte Porena is an acolyte in Stormwind City.
Shoni commands the underground assault crew preparing for the battle for Gnomeregan. She needs help equipping its gyrodrillmatic excavationators.
Innkeeper Allison welcomes weary travelers and offers lodging and goods. In a seasonal Hallow's End exchange, she playfully praises a visitor's strength after a flex and offers a treat.
Renzik is an SI:7 operative at SI:7 headquarters in Old Town. He takes in promising recruits for SI:7 training and sends them to his associate Lucius in Lakeshire for field experience.

Doc Mixilpixil is an eccentric doctor who examines patients and investigates possible cures. His cheerfully unsettling bedside manner includes consulting unusual companions, such as a squirrel and a statue.
Noarm is a critter in Stormwind City.
Borgus Steelhand trains weaponsmiths. His training responses are brusque: he objects to interruptions and dismisses an unsuitable weapon.
Shailiea is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Thelman Slatefist serves as an Alterac Valley battlemaster. He welcomes fighters willing to help in the valley.

Tyrion is an undercover operative who uses Spybot to get close to Lord Gregor Lescovar. He arranged a meeting with Marzon and planted false information to create an opening for an ambush. Secretive and watchful, he expects others to avoid alerting Lescovar.

Hank the Hammer is a smith of the Mithril Order. Dwarf smith Galvan trained him, and Hank carries forward Galvan’s promise to teach those with the desire and determination to advance in blacksmithing. He trusts a diligent apprentice to prove worthy of further guidance.
Brother Sarno welcomes visitors to the Cathedral of Light.
Lillian Singh is a holiday fireworks vendor who offers goods to visitors.
Master Wood grows irritable when people make certain gestures at him, warning that he will beat some manners into them; another gesture leaves him visibly unimpressed.
Lil Timmy is a boy who offers kittens to anyone willing to give them a good home.
Auctioneer Chilton provides auction services.
Auctioneer Fitch handles auctions in Stormwind.
Tyrion's Spybot is a courteous, obedient mechanical attendant who seeks Lord Lescovar, announces his guest, and waits to serve.
Jalane Ayrole is a Master Shadoweave Tailor who offers tailoring training.
Sylista tends the stables, helping travelers stable their pets or recover lost companions.
Royal Factor Bathrilor serves Stormwind's census bureau, consulting its population records to help locate people. He describes accessing those records through arcane methods and disciplined study.
Sprite Jumpsprocket is an apprentice engineer with an exuberant fondness for explosions; she greets the day as a fine opportunity to blow something up.
Betty Quin is an apprentice enchanter who welcomes travelers and asks what brings them to her doorstep.
Jenova Stoneshield is a stable master who offers pet stabling and help recovering lost companions.
Randal Worth is an apprentice leatherworker learning the craft's techniques. He says Simon helps him and calls him a good sport.
Nara Meideros is a priest trainer who offers training. She greets visitors with a blessing in Elune's name.
Kimberly Grant is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Kelly Grant is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Woo Ping is a weapon master who discusses armed-combat training and what other weapon masters teach.
Imelda is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Brother Crowley serves as a Scarlet Crusade emissary. His quest lead concerns Brother Anton, who seeks help against an undead threat in Desolace.
Melris Malagan is the Captain of the Guard.
Justine Demalier is a Stormwind Recruiter.
Lieutenant Rachel Vaccar is an Outland armor quartermaster. She sells goods and offers repairs.
Archmage Gaiman is an archmage in Stormwind City.
Sergeant Major Skyshadow is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Master Sergeant Biggins is an accessories quartermaster who sells goods.
Lieutenant Karter is a war mount quartermaster who offers goods for sale.
Lieutenant Jackspring is a legacy weapon quartermaster who offers goods for sale and repairs.
Sergeant Major Clate is a legacy armor quartermaster who offers goods for sale and repairs.
A guard named Quine.
A guard named Hammon.
Lord Tony Romano is a rogue trainer with a wary, wry manner; his greeting jokes that visitors may be after his coin purse.
Khole Jinglepocket promotes Smokywood Pastures products, including seasonal treats and wrapping paper.
Guchie Jinglepocket is associated with Smokywood Pastures.
Major Mattingly publicly addresses Stormwind’s citizens and allies, celebrating the defeat of Onyxia and honoring the heroes. He also rallies listeners with praise for the Alliance.
Officer Jaxon is an officer in Stormwind City who fights by throwing hooked nets.
Officer Pomeroy is an officer in Stormwind City who fights by throwing hooked nets.
Officer Brady is an officer in Stormwind City who fights by throwing hooked nets.
Orphan Matron Nightingale cares for orphaned children at Stormwind's orphanage. Her welcome describes Children's Week as the Alliance's spring effort to give those children attention.
Emmithue Smails sells sweet treats.
A Stormwind orphan in Stormwind City.
Shellene is an orphanage matron who responds to children with concern and reassurance, urging them to trust in the Light.
Field Marshal Afrasiabi is an Alliance officer who addresses Stormwind's citizens and rallies them around their champions.
Clavicus Knavingham serves as Stormwind's Alliance cloth quartermaster, seeking donations to replenish the city's textile stocks.
Elfarran serves as Warsong Gulch's battlemaster and courteously offers adventurers help with their journey there.
Lady Hoteshem serves as Arathi Basin's battlemaster and courteously addresses adventurers seeking entry.
Jesper is sick and longs to go trick-or-treating for Hallow’s End. Unable to go, Jesper asks others to bring treats back to the orphanage.
An Alliance brigadier general who speaks of the Alliance's war against the Horde as a time of great need and calls on its people to do their part.
Elder Hammershout speaks of the new year, the bright moon, and the awakening of the ancients. Visitors can ask where to find Elders Bladeswift, Bronzebeard, Rumblerock, and Stormbrow.
Auctioneer Jaxon is an auctioneer in Stormwind City who runs auctions for visitors.
A Stormwind Reveler joins festive gatherings, sharing party chatter about fireworks and travel between celebrations.
Master Sergeant Maclure recruits support for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort and directs interested visitors to speak with his commander.
Officer Maloof serves Stormwind as a commendation officer, receiving Alliance Commendation Signets and recording adventurers’ service for Stormwind recognition.
Colara Dean waits for someone special, prefers the scent of cologne, and brusquely tells heartbroken visitors to return when less sad.
Jocryn Heldric bears the rank of lieutenant.
Peddlefeet is a non-combat pet found in Stormwind City.
Aristan Mottar has noticed far more people than usual, guards included, going in and out of The Gilded Rose. He sends people to ask Innkeeper Allison there where they came from.

Evert Sorisam is a newly arrived Stormwind merchant supplying sought-after cologne. Accused of treason, Evert insists the trade is harmless and helps ease courtship. To demonstrate good intent, Evert names Staffron Lerent as the supplier but says they have never spoken: an unnamed goblin middleman provided the Hillsbrad location beyond Ravenholdt Manor.
An Argent Dawn paladin.
An Argent Dawn crusader.
An Argent Dawn champion.

Lieutenant Orrin serves the Argent Dawn at Stormwind and directs inquiries into Scourge activity outside the city. He asks investigators to study strange runic circles and bring proof against the undead; another assignment brings him a cracked necrotic crystal.

An Argent Dawn quartermaster, this representative directs those seeking orders against the Scourge to Light's Hope Chapel. Visitors can also ask to spend their runes, reflecting the quartermaster's role in the order's festival services.
Emissary Taluun presents as an emissary and greets visitors courteously.
Squire Rowe addresses visitors formally as citizens or champions, and asks those with no questions to move along.
A human commoner who shares seasonal folklore and festival news, including Lunar Festival traditions in Moonglade and Winter Veil gifts in Ironforge.
Harbinger Ennarth is based in Stormwind City.
Beka Zipwhistle is an arena battlemaster associated with the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit. Her arena dialogue asks whether a visitor has what it takes to compete in its arena battlegrounds.
Jovil is the Eye of the Storm battlemaster, who enlists fighters for that battle.
Farseer Umbrua is a shaman trainer whom Emissary Taluun brought to teach new allies about the elements of this world. Umbrua says no one will listen.
Little Noah says he wants to become a tanner when he grows up.
Alicia says she wrote a poem for her friend Caylee Dak, and that her mother considers her too young to travel to Shattrath herself.
Fuzz is a critter in Stormwind City.
A Midsummer Supplier is a seller of goods for the fire festival.

An Earthen Ring elder who treats the Twilight Cult as a threat to the balance the Ring fights to preserve. In public, they call stopping the cult a sworn duty, warning that its success would undo their work. Their appeal is urgent and collective, rooted in responsibility for the balance.
Leesha Tannerby is a dockmaster. She identifies the steam-powered Kraken as sailing to Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.
Miles Sidney sells poison supplies and presses Wright to finish a new concoction, complaining about spores filling his shop.
Wright Williams works on poison recipes, adjusting ingredients for Deadly Poisons and Anesthetics. He reports progress to a superior and will not sell a recipe until satisfied with it.
Nayura is a dockmaster. She says The Bravery travels from this dock between Stormwind and Auberdine.
A steam tank engineer.
A humanoid Dockhand in Stormwind City.
A Stormwind Cannoneer stationed in Stormwind City.
Ian Drake is an elder who greets visitors and asks for the secret code from the Worldwide Invitational event, to be whispered in his ear. In return he gives a gift, Tyrael's Hilt.
Jelinek Sharpshear is a barber who welcomes visitors and offers grooming and appearance services, including hair and facial-hair styling, piercings, and other customizations.
A Stormwind dock worker.
Thargold Ironwing offers a flight over Stormwind Harbor, described as a peaceful bird’s-eye view.
Captain Paul Carver is the captain associated with The Assurance.
Engineer Kurtis Paddock serves The Assurance as an engineer. He sells goods and reagents and repairs equipment.
First Mate Edgar Flores is identified as a first mate of The Assurance.
Navigator Rian Trost is identified as a navigator of The Assurance.
Galley Chief Paul Kubit offers goods for sale under The Assurance.
Art Peshkov is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Daniel Kramer is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Candace Thomas is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Meghan Dawson is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Justin Boehm, of The Assurance, is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Michael Corpora, of The Assurance, is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Benjamin Elgueta, known as The Assurance, is a humanoid in Stormwind City.
Serban Oprescu is a humanoid of The Assurance.
Robert Richardson is a humanoid of The Assurance.

King Varian Wrynn rules Stormwind and values the heroes who defended the Alliance during his absence. He describes fighting across Azeroth to rediscover his past and reclaim his throne. He directs investigators to Mathias Shaw for information about Nathanos Marris and is the intended recipient of reports on Nathanos’s fate.
A Stormwind Harbor guard who helps visitors find their way to the auction house, Bank of Stormwind, Stormwind Harbor and Deeprun Tram.
Benik Boltshear is a locksmith who offers help to people who have lost keys. His help covers keys associated with Scholomance, The Arcatraz, The Shattered Halls and Searing Gorge.
Steven Allen is an exhausted worker associated with Harbor Road who longs for dwarven ale, a good cry, and a nap.

Bethany Aldire is the Strand of the Ancients battlemaster. She says the Horde must not be allowed to turn the strand's hidden secrets against us, and asks willing fighters to join the brave soldiers there.
Catarina Stanford is an Inscription trainer. Visitors can ask her for training.
Stanly McCormick supplies inscription goods to customers.
Lady Jaina Proudmoore is Theramore's ruler and urges restraint toward the Horde, stressing peace and the Warchief's good faith.
Lieutenant Tristia serves as the Veteran Armor Quartermaster, offering goods.
Captain Dirgehammer serves as the Apprentice Armor Quartermaster, offering goods and repair service.
Knight-Lieutenant Moonstrike serves as the Armor Quartermaster, offering goods and repair service.
Captain Dirgehammer is an apprentice armor quartermaster who offers goods and repairs.
Captain Dirgehammer is an apprentice armor quartermaster who offers goods and repairs.
Lieutenant Tristia is a veteran armor quartermaster who offers goods.
Lieutenant Tristia is a veteran armor quartermaster who sells goods and repairs equipment.
Captain O'Neal is a jewelcrafting quartermaster who sells goods.
Devin Fardale is an Alliance battlemaster who asks whether people are ready to fight for the Alliance.
Alison Devay is an Alliance battlemaster who asks whether people are ready to fight for the Alliance.
Dracien Flanning is the Isle of Conquest battlemaster. She warns that its valuable resources must not fall into Horde hands and asks people to join the fight.
Behsten is an Experience Eliminator. For a fee he lets people stay forever at their present strength, and for the same fee he undoes it.
Little Adeline helps the Gumps run their shop and loves flowers; she enjoys asking visitors whether they do too.
Arcanist Paharin is a Wintergrasp battle-mage of the Horde, which holds Wintergrasp Fortress. He sends people to Wintergrasp when the battle begins, to support the Horde's forces.
Snivel Rustrocket is affiliated with the Venture Co. His greeting to an unfamiliar visitor is guarded and dismissive.

Kwee Q. Peddlefeet represents the Crown Chemical Co. as an official Crown event mascot and explains the Charitable Charms program, which uses Lovely Charm Collector's Kits to make bracelets for friends and loved ones.
Inspector Snip Snagglebolt investigates the Crown Chemical Company for the Steamwheedle cartel, suspicious of its perfume and its effects. He speaks bluntly and distrusts the company's products.
Marion Sutton fell for Snivel Rustrocket and his promise of a South Seas holiday. His disappearance leaves Marion suspicious of his honesty.
Knight-Lieutenant T'Maire Sydes is a Northrend armor quartermaster who offers goods and repairs.

place_records.text: You are in Stormwind City, Alliance land in the Eastern Kingdoms. Nearly all of its people are Alliance, and city guards and patrollers keep order in the streets. The Defias are a danger here, and an investigation into them is still going on. Sewer beasts are a danger in the city as well.

You are in the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City. Officers here address the crowd, celebrating the defeat of Onyxia and rallying citizens around their champions. Farseer Umbrua, a shaman trainer, teaches the elements to new allies. High Commander Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind Defense is waiting on the King's answer to a report from Magistrate Solomon seeking reinforcements for besieged Lakeshire.

You are in Stormwind Harbor, part of Stormwind City. Dockmasters Leesha Tannerby and Nayura work this dock. The steam-powered Kraken sails from here to Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra, and The Bravery sails between Stormwind and Auberdine. Captain Paul Carver is associated with The Assurance, and its engineer, Kurtis Paddock, sells goods and repairs equipment.
